notes: Purpose לְ + infinitive: complementizer to the preposition, supplied subject and modal to the infinitive (rule 52).
נָכְרִיָּה is an anarthrous substantive the ASV completes with a bare *the* (rule 46), so it is a written antecedent and the relative over the juxtaposed finite clause is added (rules 46 and 55).
אֲמָרֶיהָ is what הֶחֱלִיקָה governs, so the supplied *with* is the verb's under rule 44 rather than the noun's under rule 33.
The Hebrew gloss *maketh smooth her words* corroborates the recasting and decides nothing (rule 38).
